admission.justification: The tick, the activity-record reader, the held-receipt queue and the bounded sweep together replace a queue that waited for the next message; the turn-end cases witness the exact behaviour.

applicability: Every native role message the product holds because its recipient could not take it, whether the hold is a recipient's ended turn or a provider limit.
conditions: The serving loop runs the held-delivery tick; delivery follows the host's own activity record where it shows the recipient idle, closed or ended.

turn_ended_agents bookmarks each non-in-turn agent per reader seen map by its published eventAt or by unstamped:<boot_id> when eventAt is absent, emitting an unstamped entry at most once per plugin boot and re-emitting on a real eventAt transition or new bootId without fabricating eventAt or affecting new_stamped_ends.
The sweep stays the fallback and visits receipts that hold messages before the other receipts.
A closed session may be reopened by ordinary delivery. A running turn or an open permission still defers a send under the existing policy.
The provider limit check reads the limit file before the ordinary recipient host read. The provider-limit hold carries the reset time.

A limited recipient published ended may receive one exact archive-or-absence confirmation for a new event stamp, or for the boot stamp when event time is absent. Confirmed archive or absence resolves waiting messages as undelivered. An unreachable host releases the drain claim with a host-unreachable outcome. Otherwise the hold remains until reset. A closed session incurs no confirmation read. After reset, eligible messages drain in order when the bounded receipt cursor reaches the recipient. Later ticks can be needed.

A reserved deferred held seat (is_deferred_held_receipt) has no host agent or usage report yet, so _deliver_or_hold and pause_for_provider_limit bypass provider-limit holds and ended-stamp absence reads before opening; once opened, later messages are held normally.
exclusions: No later message is needed or sent to trigger the delivery.
The parent wake line of the host plugin is MIK-R172's, not this clause's.
The presenter's send is out of scope.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_held_queue.py::TurnEndDeliveryTests::test_a_turn_end_delivers_what_waits_without_another_message and ::test_a_turn_end_holds_the_message_while_a_permission_still_waits (class run: 18 passed); report role-reports/worker/8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c/role-launch/260928-MIK-L171-worker-8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c.md; L171-F03 repair: test_a_queued_receipt_past_the_first_slice_is_reached_within_bounded_ticks at queue sizes 33 and 65

statement: A held message can be delivered after the activity publication reports the recipient idle, closed or ended and ordinary delivery gates allow it, with unstamped turn-end entries deduplicated per reader once per plugin boot without fabricating event timestamps. The product’s own tick visits bounded units without a whole per-tick census. A provider-limit hold carries its reset time and applies only once a host agent exists: a reserved deferred held seat bypasses pre-open provider-limit holds and ended-stamp absence reads on its first message, while post-open messages are held normally. An ended observation during a live recipient's hold can be confirmed as archive or absence, resolving its waiting messages undelivered.
title: Turn-end and provider-limit delivery with per-boot unstamped dedup
